description: Fictional shared-line appearance, presence, pickup, parking, and retrieval mechanics. No real calling or vendor parity is asserted.

sourceLimits.design: The preserved communications design explicitly lists shared lines within enterprise voice. The mapping has no individual source row for shared line appearances, busy-lamp presence, call pickup, or park/retrieve.
sourceLimits.decomposition: These gameplay rules decompose the mapped directory, signaling, identity and continuity obligations. The cosmetic Shared Line Huggers row is flavor only.
sourceLimits.completion: This pack does not claim full source mapping, real vendor compatibility, call resolution, healthy media, or progression-level completion.

lineSchema.tenant: Existing canonical tenant ID; members must all belong to it unless the parent explicitly validates federation.
lineSchema.owner: Canonical member ID; no implicit rights are granted.
lineSchema.members: Canonical identities with explicit observe, answer, dnd, park, and retrieve rights.
lineSchema.capacity: Synthetic maximum simultaneous ringing, active, and parked calls on this line.
lineSchema.parkSlots: Named slots park-1 through park-N, independent of line session capacity.
lineSchema.ringMinutes: Simulated ringing timeout; parent owns the terminal call outcome.
lineSchema.parkMinutes: Synthetic retrieval deadline; it never resolves or terminates a parent call by itself.
lineSchema.dnd: Desired/effective line-level DND, separate from each member's observed presence.

acceptanceCases.positive: A staged line becomes effective only after its canonical tenant members and endpoints are validated.
acceptanceCases.negative: Unknown identity, cross-tenant member, missing entitlement, duplicate member, or invalid permissions are rejected.

acceptanceCases.positive: Available members ring when line DND is disabled; member presence changes do not change line DND.
acceptanceCases.negative: Offline/busy/DND members do not receive pickup eligibility, and line DND blocks new ringing even when members are available.

acceptanceCases.positive: Ringing occupancy consumes shared line capacity until answer, park/retrieve, or parent-confirmed terminal release.
acceptanceCases.negative: A concurrent attempt at capacity is rejected without creating a second occupancy.

acceptanceCases.positive: Each member can observe, answer, change line DND, park, and retrieve only the permissions explicitly granted; a retrieve-only member can retrieve without answer rights.
acceptanceCases.negative: Membership alone does not grant pickup, DND, park, or retrieval, and one person cannot hold two active calls.

acceptanceCases.positive: An authorized available alternate appearance can answer one actual ringing interaction.
acceptanceCases.negative: Foreign tenant, stale interaction, non-answer member, or unavailable endpoint cannot pick it up.

acceptanceCases.positive: An authorized active member parks a live interaction in an unused configured slot; an authorized same-tenant member retrieves it before deadline.
acceptanceCases.negative: Duplicate/invalid slots, missing permissions, stale calls, and timed-out retrieval are rejected.

acceptanceCases.positive: Assessment and inspection report state-derived decisions without changing state.
acceptanceCases.negative: Blocked actions do not mutate parent interaction phases, media, usage, or resolution evidence.

acceptanceCases.positive: Strict save validation and worker source preserve staged state, occupancy, permissions, and trace decisions.
acceptanceCases.negative: Corrupt generations, fabricated interaction references, core phase/line/deadline mismatch, duplicate slots, tenant mismatch, and fabricated success traces fail.

acceptanceCases.positive: Typed admin controls configure lines and record synthetic presence observations through shared dispatch.
acceptanceCases.negative: Read-only mode disables every mutating control.

acceptanceCases.positive: The panel exposes actual core interaction IDs and shared-service decisions while leaving final call outcomes to core.
acceptanceCases.negative: The UI cannot create a successful call, healthy media, or a terminal resolution itself.
